lookback_notes: NOT_FOUND. The Area 2 entry on p. 3 states only that the service must be documented in the record and that the claim is disallowed if service documentation is missing; no observation/look-back window in days is stated for this audit area. The document's overall scope is a service-date range (01/01/2013 through 10/31/2025), which is a claim-period scope, not an assessor look-back window.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Scope: this audit protocol applies to ALP service dates 01/01/2013 through 10/31/2025.

Services provided and billed in accordance with the listed NYSDOH COVID-19 PHE guidance will not be subject to disallowance, provided all other programmatic and billing requirements not altered or waived by the PHE guidance were met.

source.quote: Services provided and billed in accordance with COVID-19 PHE guidance issued by the NYS Department of Health (DOH) pertaining to ALP services will not be subject to disallowance, provided all other programmatic and billing requirements not altered or waived by the PHE guidance were met.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Flexibilities regarding minimum billing standards and documentation requirements ended when the PHE expired at the end of the day on May 11, 2023, unless otherwise specified by DOH through formal regulatory waivers.

source.quote: On the date the PHE ended, the flexibilities afforded providers regarding minimum billing standards and documentation requirements also ended, unless otherwise specified by DOH through formal regulatory waivers.
